article_context: The body image introduces the section “Жемчуг всегда прав!” and pairs Balmain and Chanel runway references with MIUZ pearl-and-diamond earrings. Its editorial role is to present pearls as a perennial trend that can read either classically elegant or boldly oversized, with special emphasis on the pendant pearl’s pendulum-like movement.
image_reading: A white editorial collage combines two tightly cropped runway portraits with two isolated pairs of silver-tone, diamond-set pearl earrings.

The lower-center earrings have large teardrop pearls suspended from narrow stone-set bars; these are the clearest physically movable elements, while the models and the ornate round pearl earrings can remain still.
Black runway clothing and backgrounds frame the pale pearls, making their scale, luster, and statement character the dominant visual detail.

models.positive_prompt: The two hanging teardrop pearls begin a small, even pendulum swing in opposite phases, their highlights sliding across the curved surfaces. Fixed camera. By the final frames both pearls return close to vertical with only a faint residual sway.
models.scene_plan: For 3.2 seconds, keep the camera fixed on the full collage. Start the two lower pendant pearls moving immediately in compact, even arcs, slightly out of phase so their individual suspension remains readable. Let the motion naturally lose amplitude, ending near vertical in the final frames without becoming fully static too early.

models.positive_prompt: The hanging teardrop pearls sway gently like pendulums in alternating arcs while soft highlights travel over their surfaces. The camera makes a slow minimal push toward the pearl earrings. Near the end, both pendants ease back toward vertical with a delicate residual motion.
models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, animate a relaxed pendulum sway in the two lower earrings, using moderate initial arcs that gradually narrow. Add one very slow, minimal push-in toward the lower-center pearl pair to emphasize the classic pendant design without cropping the runway references. Finish with both pearls nearly vertical and still visibly settling.

models.positive_prompt: With the camera fixed, the two hanging pearls make one smooth outward-and-back pendulum sway as their luster shifts naturally. They finish nearly vertical, carrying a subtle final oscillation.
models.scene_plan: Use the four-second shot for one smooth, clearly legible swing cycle of the lower pendant pearls. Keep the camera fixed and the amplitude modest: the pearls drift outward, reverse naturally, and return toward center as their surface highlights shift. End with both pendants nearly vertical and a slight remaining oscillation.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Pearls remain an enduring fashion choice, equally suited to classic pendant earrings and bold statement styling.
structured_intent.primary_action: The hanging teardrop pearls sway gently like pendulums.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The collage continues to present pearl earrings as confident, desirable statement jewelry through the final frame.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The pendant pearls finish close to their vertical resting position with only a slight residual sway.
